title: Configuring Layer 2 EtherChannel with LACP
summary: Bundle multiple physical Ethernet links into a single logical channel using standard Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) to increase bandwidth and provide link redundancy.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational advantages and prerequisites of link aggregation using EtherChannel
Configure dynamic LACP link bundling across multiple physical switch ports
Configure trunking encapsulation and allowed VLANs on a Port-channel logical interface
Verify EtherChannel status using show etherchannel summary and interpret port flags

source.origin: Independently authored switching guide replacing legacy courseware answer guide
